rules.objective: Be the first partnership to reach 104 or more cumulative points. Points are scored by bidding and making tricks; failed bids score for the opponents.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal: 13 cards each, counterclockwise; dealer may cut but not shuffle after first deal. 2. Bidding: From dealer's right, each player speaks once (pass/ter/behi ter or bid 8-13 tricks or double 13). Highest bidder is declarer, chooses trump, leads first trick with a trump. 3. Play: Follow suit; winner of trick leads next. Play ends when declarer's side makes or loses the bid. 4. Scoring: Won bid scores tricks bid; lost bid scores twice that many to opponents. Double 13 scores 26 or 52. First to 104 wins.
keyRules: Declarer must lead trump to first trick
Follow suit if possible; no requirement to win the trick after the first
Game is 104 points; won bid = tricks bid, lost bid = twice that to opponents

strategy.basic: Use pass (ter, behi ter) to signal hand strength to partner; bid when holding trumps and high cards.
strategy.intermediate: Count trumps and key cards; use allowed signals (slam for suit lead, edge tap for associated suit, release to show void).
strategy.advanced: Coordinate with partner through legal signals; press bids when the hand supports raising.
tips: Slamming a card requests partner to lead that suit; edge tap requests the associated suit (hearts-spades, diamonds-clubs).

scoring.description: Won bid scores as many points as tricks bid; lost bid scores twice that many to the opponents. Double 13 scores 26 if won, 52 to opponents if lost. Failed bid of 8 by fourth player after three passes scores only 8 to opponents.
scoring.winCondition: First partnership to reach 104 or more cumulative points wins the game.
